args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and began failing health checks, with a 18% error rate. SRE agent rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions. Post-rollback, health checks pass and the error rate is down to 0.2%. The v2.3.1 release remains unhealthy and should not be redeployed without investigation.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Prior release v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api rolled back to **v2.3.0** across all production regions.
3. **Verified**: Health checks now pass and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer and documents the rollback and current recovery state.

All regions are healthy again, and the incident is open for follow-up on the v2.3.1 failure root cause.
